# Third-party notices

`benchmarks/baseline.json` records feature labels and command identifiers from Wordcraft's `crates/engine/src/catalog.rs` at revision `159b84f54c74e9e82fb3109b758ae7dd6f4e3ab0`, https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft. Wordcraft is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; the MIT notice is retained in `wordcraft-LICENSE-MIT`. No Wordcraft engine implementation, brand graphics or bundled fonts are included here.

The CN1 application wrapper and Maven/IDE helper files at the repository root were generated by the Codename One Maven archetype. Existing notices in those files remain intact. Codename One and other Maven dependencies retain their respective licenses; they are not relicensed by this project. Dependency/runtime distribution notices must be audited before a packaged public release.

A license for this new project's original source has not yet been selected.

`formats/src/main/java/com/codenameone/wordprocessor/PdfMetrics.java` contains WinAnsi character
advance widths derived from Adobe's 1997 Core 14 Helvetica and Helvetica-Bold AFM files, as
shipped in Prawn 2.4.0. Oblique faces have the same advances. The modification reduces AFM data
to numeric width arrays and maps nonbreaking space/soft hyphen to space/hyphen. The original
copyright is retained in the Java source and the unmodified [Adobe AFM notice](Adobe-AFM-MustRead.html)
is included with native and JavaSE distributions. No font outline files are included.

Bundled document fonts: Adobe Source Sans 3 and Source Serif 4, and JetBrains Mono, under SIL OFL 1.1. Unmodified font files and copyright/license notices are included in `formats/src/main/resources`. These files were taken from the pinned Wordcraft source asset set.

PDF fallback faces, unmodified: NotoSansHebrew-Regular/Bold.ttf and NotoNaskhArabic-Regular/Bold.ttf (hinted TTF from the notofonts/notofonts.github.io repository), SIL OFL 1.1, with `OFL-NotoSansHebrew.txt` and `OFL-NotoNaskhArabic.txt` alongside them in `common/src/main/resources`.

Additional unmodified font faces: SourceSans3-BoldIt.ttf from Adobe source-sans release 3.052R; JetBrainsMono-Bold.ttf, JetBrainsMono-Italic.ttf and JetBrainsMono-BoldItalic.ttf from JetBrainsMono v2.304. The same bundled SIL OFL notices apply.

Unicode 16.0.0 grapheme-break, emoji and Indic-conjunct property data and the official grapheme test corpus are pinned under `unicode-16.0.0`, with original download URLs and SHA-256 hashes in `manifest.json`. `scripts/generate-grapheme-ranges.py` verifies those inputs and generates `GraphemeProperties.java`. The unmodified [Unicode license](unicode-16.0.0/LICENSE.txt) accompanies these data and their derived tables. Generated tables count toward application source totals.

English proofing data under `document/src/main/resources/proof/`, taken unmodified from the pinned Wordcraft source asset set:

| File | Content | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `en-us.dic` | Hyphenation/spelling word list derived from the Moby Hyphenator II list by Grady Ward (Project Gutenberg #3204), front-coded and raw-deflated | Public domain |
| `en-us.pat` | US English Liang hyphenation patterns trained from the Moby list | CC0 / public domain |
| `en-extra.txt` | Supplemental modern English spelling words written by Wordcraft contributors | MIT (see `wordcraft-LICENSE-MIT`) |

## image-webp (MIT)

`Vp8Decoder.java` ports the lossy WebP (VP8) decoding tables and logic of the
[image-webp](https://github.com/image-rs/image-webp) crate, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Copyright (c) The image-rs Developers. The MIT license permits use, copying, modification and
distribution provided this copyright notice and permission notice are included.

Proofing languages (Polish, Portuguese): no third-party dictionary is bundled. Like Wordcraft,
which reads system-installed Hunspell `.aff`/`.dic` pairs and bundles none for these languages,
`ProofLanguages` reads `pl_PL`/`pt_BR`/`pt_PT` pairs from the usual system locations at runtime
(each dictionary keeps its own license, typically GPL/LGPL/MPL, and is never redistributed here).
The test dictionaries in `ProofLanguagesTest` are synthetic and original to this project.
